hypothesis: Trying the existing allocator before repeating a cold cache lookup in swapin_sync reduces fixed synchronous swap-in work without changing allocator checks. Reject on correctness or metadata failure, random-latency regression, or no useful resolved paired gain.

mechanism.claim: A successful cold synchronous swap-in executes one fewer swap_cache_get_folio lookup inside swapin_sync. Both locked allocation checks remain; -EEXIST falls back to a referenced cached folio and retries if it vanished.
mechanism.falsifier: An exact-tree review finds that a caller loses cache-hit progress, required lifetime/error protection or a preserved allocator check, or the cold success path still performs the duplicate lookup. Correctness, metadata and calibrated latency independently gate execution.

reason: Both anonymous and shmem callers already missed the cache. This independent lookup-order change retains the allocator protections modified in the earlier r01 hypothesis and adds no persistent state.
